prompt_meta.title: GitHub Integration + Build Speed: Fix Next.js web build hang, accelerate pnpm monorepo builds with caching, push to GitHub with guard rails

owner_actions.when: after STEP-0013 report is shared with ChatGPT
owner_actions.instruction: Approve the Git workflow/guard rails described in ops/GIT_WORKFLOW.md and ops/CI_CACHING.md. Approval only; no local command execution.

step_objectives.goal: Make builds reliable and fast, then push to GitHub with enforcement guard rails so development speed increases without risking corruption or broken main.
outcomes: apps/web build hang/fail is resolved; pnpm build gates can pass reliably
pnpm monorepo build time is improved via caching/config (local + CI) and documented with before/after timings
GitHub remote is configured and code is pushed to https://github.com/AkshayDubey29/NoriJjak.git on main
Guard rails exist: pre-push or equivalent enforcement so bad changes are blocked; CI required checks are stable and documented
CI caches are configured for pnpm + (optional) Next build cache to speed pipelines
constraints: No new product features (no new domains, screens, flows). This step is build/release/dev-speed only.
Owner does not execute local commands; IDE must run everything. If GitHub auth is needed, capture as limitation with exact remediation.
definition_of_done: pnpm -r build succeeds (including apps/web) and no longer hangs; root gates are green locally
Build speed improvements implemented and measured (before/after) for pnpm -r build (or the chosen canonical build command)
CI updated with effective caching (pnpm store + build caches as applicable) and documented
Git configured: origin set to repo URL, main branch pushed, and CI workflows present in repo
Guard rails implemented (pre-push hooks and/or branch protection attempt via gh; minimum: local hooks + CI required checks documented)

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Make Next.js build reliable and deterministic.
requirements: Identify root cause of apps/web build hang/fail and fix it.
Ensure build does not rely on missing env vars for production build (provide safe defaults or documented build-time env policy).
Ensure build can run in CI headlessly.
acceptance_criteria: Report includes root cause analysis and evidence (logs/timings)

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Reduce iteration time without weakening quality gates.
requirements: Implement caching and/or orchestration so repeated builds are significantly faster.
CI must cache pnpm store at minimum; optionally cache Next build artifacts safely.
Choose a canonical build command and document it.
Capture before/after timings for the same command on the same machine.
acceptance_criteria: Report includes before/after wall-clock build times and what changed
CI workflow shows cache hit/miss outputs and improved job duration notes

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Push code to GitHub with enforcement that prevents broken main.
requirements: Configure git remote origin to repo URL and push main.
Ensure .gitignore is correct for node/next/expo/prisma artifacts.
Guard rails: implement a pre-push (or equivalent) hook that runs integrity + lint + test (and optionally build) with a reasonable strategy; document how to bypass in emergencies.
CI workflows must run release gates + integrity and have stable job names intended for 'required checks'.
Attempt branch protection setup via GitHub CLI if available and authenticated; if not possible, document exact limitation and the minimal owner action needed.
acceptance_criteria: Repo has main branch with code and CI workflows present
Report includes git commands run and push evidence (commit hash + remote confirmation logs)
Guard rails are present in repo (not only local untracked hooks) and documented

tasks.name: Diagnose & fix apps/web build hang/failure
tasks.objective: Make Next.js build complete successfully and deterministically.
acceptance: pnpm --filter apps/web build succeeds and pnpm -r build succeeds

tasks.name: Optimize monorepo build speed
tasks.objective: Implement caching/orchestration to speed up pnpm -r build locally and in CI.
constraints: Must document canonical build command and cache strategy
acceptance: Before/after timings captured and meaningful improvement shown (or explained if not possible)

tasks.name: GitHub integration and push
tasks.objective: Set origin remote and push main branch to the GitHub repo.
constraints: If auth required, attempt standard non-interactive methods first, then report limitation clearly
acceptance: git remote -v shows origin set; push succeeds; commit hash recorded

tasks.name: Guard rails enforcement
tasks.objective: Add guard rails for pushing/merging to main via hooks + CI required checks policy docs.
constraints: Must be repo-stored and reproducible; do not rely solely on local untracked hooks
acceptance: Pre-push (or equivalent) is active; CI checks stable and documented; attempt branch protection via gh if feasible

tasks.name: Docs + manifest + report
tasks.objective: Write docs, update manifest, produce complete report.
acceptance: Docs complete; manifest updated; report complete
